policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, link check, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
